Name: Aviroen's RRRR vanillaish Eskbl Magnus
Author: aviroen
Description:
[size=6]This mod has been abandoned because I'm too lazy to make world sprites
Check out my other problematic project: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27718]Lance Super Sweet Expanded[/url][/size]

I have made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22691]VampireCowboi's [/url]world sprites of Magnus with less cowboy hat, fixed the disappearing for "hand holding" required by RRRR
These portraits are heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7529]Eskbl[/url] but with my own flourishes of emotes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Jellonip
[/url]﻿Currently I'm working on my version for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284/]Jellonip's[/url] events
These portraits are very biased, modern-central, and I am going to attempt an editing of text from Jellonip's original hair events so that the text isn't so obnoxiously skewed, stick around for updates on that.
